config.scope: Constructed native encoded-fault plumbing diagnostic; no training, robustness or physical representativeness claim
reconstruction_choices: Use the existing constructed_scenario('crossing','M100',920001): two 2 km crossing routes, both aircraft admitted at zero. Keep the original execution environment, native physics, timing, termination and truth-risk accounting.

Initialize one untrained SharedActorCritic on CPU with model seed 930001; eval mode and gradients disabled. Reset the original select_actions CPU sampling generator to 940001 per case. No checkpoint, optimizer, training update or extra forward pass exists.

Plain passes the original clean environment observations. Emptyplan calls transform with an empty plan; disabled calls it with a valid missing plan and enabled=False. Missing replaces own speed slot 2 with 2.0; abnormal replaces it with -0.5; falsified swaps original own slots 2 and 3. Apply the explicitly declared plan to every currently inferred ownship at each decision; this is no inferred event rate or random distribution.

Before and after every transformation compare clean feature/mask/ID packets, physical AircraftState values, native physical packets and accepted action/route fields. Check transformed masks and row IDs against clean inputs. Every live aircraft still receives ordinary policy inference and env.step actions; there is no communication holding or disappearance logic.

One passive forward hook checks the actual sorted batch, own and intruder feature bytes, padding/presence masks, action masks, finite legal logits and finite values. Invalid-action logits retain the model's negative-infinity mask. The hook returns None, performs no extra forward, and must not consume global or policy sampling RNG. Restore the hook and physical callback in finally.

Record exact source-coded fault traces, planned/applied/numeric/bit changes, clean and actual encoded packets, original sampled actions, passive forward evidence, per-physics-step truth and native conflict events. Missing/abnormal/falsified may change actions, trajectories and truth risk; no equality or improvement requirement is imposed on those cases.

Emptyplan and disabled must match plain observation/mask streams, sampled actions, forward streams, true trajectories and scientific environment summaries exactly, excluding only wall time and RSS. Full population accounting includes failures and requires neither all arrivals nor conflict elimination.

Use one global 60 s inner deadline checked between cases and decisions; controller supplies the 90 s outer launcher budget and single CPU. Retain failed/partial case files and mark cases not started after the deadline. This driver changes no running training source, model or process.

sensor_contract.scope: Explicit encoded sensor-fault supporting interface; no perturbation-trained baseline or training integration
source_facts: Paper pp.10-11 and the 08:02 review in paper/REPRODUCTION.md describe missing information as None before policy encoding, then a large finite abnormal value. The table's 2Nmax and text's 2max(N(o)) are not identical executable prescriptions.
Abnormal information must actually lie outside the normal encoding interval. The paper does not provide an executable distribution merely by writing epsilon in the real numbers.
Falsified information shuffles at least two elements. Selection axes, fields, counts and an executable selection distribution remain unspecified.

src/shared_ppo.py uses current-neighbor set attention without row ID features. Permuting complete intruder rows preserves its mathematical output, apart from floating reduction roundoff; a row shuffle is not evidence of harmful corruption.
reconstruction_choices: Apply only after the existing normalization/clipping. Input features must be finite clean [0,1] arrays; no clipping follows corruption. Missing is fixed finite 2.0, explicitly choosing 2Nmax with Nmax=1, independent of the sample's maximum. This choice is not author-confirmed.

No event sampler, rate conversion, random value distribution, curriculum, noncooperative aircraft role, missing-ownship control, GAE or training integration exists here. Caller-supplied explicit plans are the only activation mechanism; an empty plan is closed and uses no RNG. enabled=False returns unchanged copies but still validates all plans.

Abnormal plans supply one finite out-of-range value per plan. It must remain finite and outside [0,1] after conversion to the existing dtype; underflow to signed zero, rounding to an interval boundary and overflow are rejected. Use separate disjoint plans for different abnormal values.

Slots identify own columns 0..6, or intruder rows 0..N-1 and columns 0..9. IDs remain in their original row order and traces bind each selected row to its original ID. Mask and metadata are deep-copied without modification; no aircraft disappears or terminates and no feature is added.

Falsification explicitly provides permutation[k] as the original source slot for destination slots[k]. Require at least two selected scalar slots and a nonidentity bijection. Fixed points within a larger permutation are allowed; exchanging equal values can produce zero numeric changes.

Duplicate slots and overlapping plans are rejected to avoid inventing composition precedence. Validate the complete plan collection before writing any output. All permutation reads use the original clean snapshot. Previously corrupted outputs are not accepted as clean inputs for another call.

Own and intruder arrays retain shape and share the same native float16, float32 or float64 dtype; the existing encoder uses float32. The common dtype makes scalar permutation an exact relocation without cross-dtype rounding. Source arrays, masks and truth are never written.

Traces report every planned scalar, its original and resulting value and IEEE bytes, optional permutation source, row IDs, applied status and actual numeric/bit changes. Counts separate planned from applied and actual changes. Signed-zero exchanges can change bits without changing numerical value.

Complete intruder-row permutations are explicitly labelled in each plan trace. That structural flag does not claim other permutations necessarily change a policy output or cause harm. No fault plan is claimed physically representative merely because its encoding is syntactically valid.

load_config validates this fixed contract; transform accepts typed explicit plans rather than sampling or loading plans from this metadata file. The controller owns future integration and updates paper documentation.
